zh.title: 航空短訊彙整：Spokane Airport投資$335 million興建Central Hall，規劃連接三個候機區；空中巴士A320颱風戰機鼻錐雷達實驗室完成驗證飛行，正式投入運作
zh.summary: 本期收錄3則獨立消息：Spokane Airport投資$335 million興建Central Hall，規劃連接三個候機區、空中巴士A320颱風戰機鼻錐雷達實驗室完成驗證飛行，正式投入運作、空中巴士力拚年底前再交259架飛機，挑戰全年約870架目標。
body: 本期彙整3則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。部分內容摘自近期站內報導，原文與來源見文末。

1. Spokane Airport投資$335 million興建Central Hall，規劃連接三個候機區
Spokane Airport投資Central Hall，目標整合安檢

2. 空中巴士A320颱風戰機鼻錐雷達實驗室完成驗證飛行，正式投入運作
空中巴士與德國航太中心合作的A320 ATRA飛行實驗室完成驗證飛行，機頭裝有颱風戰機鼻錐，將用於測試颱風戰機新一代E-Scan雷達。

3. 空中巴士力拚年底前再交259架飛機，挑戰全年約870架目標
空中巴士10月交付74架飛機，全年累計621架；要在11、12月再交259架才能達到全年約870架的目標，單月需交約124至125架，遠高於今年單月最高的89架。

en.title: Aviation briefs: Spokane Airport Invests $335 Million in Central Hall to Connect Three Concourses; Airbus A320 flying radar lab with Eurofighter nose completes commissioning flights
en.summary: 3 independent updates: Spokane Airport Invests $335 Million in Central Hall to Connect Three Concourses; Airbus A320 flying radar lab with Eurofighter nose completes commissioning flights; Airbus aims for 259 aircraft deliveries before year end to reach annual target.
body: 3 independent aviation updates. Includes excerpts of recent reports, with original reports and sources linked below.

1. Spokane Airport Invests $335 Million in Central Hall to Connect Three Concourses
Spokane Airport invests in a Central Hall to link concourses and eliminate repeat screening by 2030.

2. Airbus A320 flying radar lab with Eurofighter nose completes commissioning flights
The Airbus A320 ATRA flying laboratory, fitted with a Eurofighter nose, has completed its commissioning flights and is now operational as a test bed for the Eurofighter's new E-Scan radar.

3. Airbus aims for 259 aircraft deliveries before year end to reach annual target
Airbus delivered 74 aircraft in October, bringing its 2026 total to 621; it needs 259 more deliveries in November and December to reach its target of around 870 for the year.
